capture_boundary: Actual synthetic ObjectStroke-to-Drawing factory path selects the V9 drawable and produces the vector records.
Each scale capture uses that same selected native RT and uploads the complete caller-produced byte stream before RTV3 Draw.
Queue execution, Mesa GLES context, explicit screen profile, output RGBA bitmap/canvas, and matrix are host supplied.
This records a bounded native Draw under a supplied matrix; it does not establish device defaults, the application canvas lifecycle, final composition, or export behavior.
Pixel support and bytes are native Mesa observations, not a claim of exact analytic-vector equivalence.

scale_1x.native_scope: Native Drawing caller plus direct RedrawPen through selected GLV9 vtable slot under an explicit synthetic profile. No serialized SDocx parser, device-default profile, renderer pixels, or SVG/PDF export.

paint.draw_pass: program 5 GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP instanced radial stamps; no final composite pass claimed

receiver.rt_plus_208_provenance: Drawing-created RT canvas slot was explicitly cleared by the host bridge to allow a separately supplied RGBA target; this does not model the saved app canvas lifecycle.
